###### Daniel 11:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:15)


וְיָבֹא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן וְיִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ סֽוֹלְלָ֔ה וְלָכַ֖ד עִ֣יר מִבְצָר֑וֹת וּזְרֹע֤וֹת הַנֶּ֙גֶב֙ לֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֔דוּ וְעַם֙ מִבְחָרָ֔יו וְאֵ֥ין כֹּ֖חַ לַעֲמֹֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mound, and seize a well fortified city and the arms of the south shall not withstand, nor his chosen people, for they shall have no strength to withstand.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the king of the north will come and spill out a siege-mound and take a fortified city. And the southern strength will fail. And [though] his chosen men [be with the kings of the south], he will be unable to withstand [the forces of the north.]


###### Daniel 11:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:16)


וְיַ֨עַשׂ הַבָּ֤א אֵלָיו֙ כִּרְצוֹנ֔וֹ וְאֵ֥ין עוֹמֵ֖ד לְפָנָ֑יו וְיַעֲמֹ֥ד בְּאֶֽרֶץ־הַצְּבִ֖י וְכָלָ֥ה בְיָדֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But he who comes against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the land of beauty, and in his hand shall be destruction.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he [(the king of the north)] who comes against him will do [with him] as he wills, and none will stand against him, and he will stand in Eretz Hatzvi [(Eretz Yisrael)], and he will destroy (it) with his forces.


###### Daniel 11:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:17)


וְיָשֵׂ֣ם׀פָּ֠נָ֠יו לָב֞וֹא בְּתֹ֧קֶף כׇּל־מַלְכוּת֛וֹ וִישָׁרִ֥ים עִמּ֖וֹ וְעָשָׂ֑ה וּבַ֤ת הַנָּשִׁים֙ יִתֶּן־ל֣וֹ לְהַשְׁחִיתָ֔הּ וְלֹ֥א תַעֲמֹ֖ד וְלֹא־ל֥וֹ תִהְיֶֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, but he shall make peace with him: and he shall give him the daughter of women, to destroy it: but she shall not stand or remain his.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he will set his face to come against the strength of his entire kingdom, and (against) the just [(those of Israel)] who are with him, and he will prevail. And he [(the king of the north, Antiochus)] will give to him [(his commander in chief, Polypus)] the daughter of women [i.e., "the choicest of women," the congregation of Israel] to destroy her; but it [(his counsel)] will not prevail, and she will not be his [(for Matithyahu the son of Yochanan will rescue her.)]


###### Daniel 11:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:18)


(וישב) [וְיָשֵׂ֧ם]׀פָּנָ֛יו לְאִיִּ֖ים וְלָכַ֣ד רַבִּ֑ים וְהִשְׁבִּ֨ית קָצִ֤ין חֶרְפָּתוֹ֙ ל֔וֹ בִּלְתִּ֥י חֶרְפָּת֖וֹ יָשִׁ֥יב לֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
After this he shall turn his face to the isles, and shall take many: but a commander shall put an end to his insult; indeed, he shall cause his insult to return upon him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he will turn his face to the isles, and he will take many. And the Chief will end his blasphemies against Him [and Israel]. He will requite unto him more than his blasphemies.


###### Daniel 11:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:19)


וְיָשֵׁ֣ב פָּנָ֔יו לְמָעוּזֵּ֖י אַרְצ֑וֹ וְנִכְשַׁ֥ל וְנָפַ֖ל וְלֹ֥א יִמָּצֵֽא׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then he shall turn his face towards the strongholds of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he will turn his face to [return to] the strongholds of his land, and he will stumble and fall and no longer be found [on earth].


###### Daniel 11:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:20)


וְעָמַ֧ד עַל־כַּנּ֛וֹ מַעֲבִ֥יר נוֹגֵ֖שׂ הֶ֣דֶר מַלְכ֑וּת וּבְיָמִ֤ים אֲחָדִים֙ יִשָּׁבֵ֔ר וְלֹ֥א בְאַפַּ֖יִם וְלֹ֥א בְמִלְחָמָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then there shall stand up in his place one who shall send an exactor of taxes throughout glory of the kingdom, but within a few days he shall be destroyed, but not in anger, or in battle.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And there will rise on his base the caster-out of the oppressor, the glory of kingdom [(the Hasmonean dynasty)]. But in a short time it will be broken — and not by the wrath [of another nation], and not by war, [(but by the contention of the brothers Aristobulus and Hyrcanus for the succession)].


###### Daniel 11:21

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:21](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:21)


וְעָמַ֤ד עַל־כַּנּוֹ֙ נִבְזֶ֔ה וְלֹא־נָתְנ֥וּ עָלָ֖יו ה֣וֹד מַלְכ֑וּת וּבָ֣א בְשַׁלְוָ֔ה וְהֶחֱזִ֥יק מַלְכ֖וּת בַּחֲלַקְלַקּֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And in his place shall stand up a vile person, to whom the honour of the kingdom has not been given: but he shall come in without difficulty, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And there will rise on his place the despised one [(Esav [Rome, viz. Ovadiah 1:2])], upon whom the majesty of kingdom was not conferred. But he will come quietly and hold the kingdom with subtlety.


###### Daniel 11:22

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:22](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:22)


וּזְרֹע֥וֹת הַשֶּׁ֛טֶף יִשָּׁטְפ֥וּ מִלְּפָנָ֖יו וְיִשָּׁבֵ֑רוּ וְגַ֖ם נְגִ֥יד בְּרִֽית׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the force of the flood shall be swept away before him, and shall be broken; even the prince of the covenant.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And those who swept [all before them] by force of arms [i.e., the Greeks] will be swept away before him, as will the maker of the covenant [i.e., the king of Israel who made a covenant with the Romans, which they broke].


###### Daniel 11:23

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:23](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:23)


וּמִן־הִֽתְחַבְּר֥וּת אֵלָ֖יו יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה מִרְמָ֑ה וְעָלָ֥ה וְעָצַ֖ם בִּמְעַט־גּֽוֹי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And from this alliance with him [(the king of Israel)] he will weave deceit [(concealing evil designs)], and he will come up [from his place] and with scant forces overcome [(his enemies around the land of Judah — Edom, Ammon, and Moav — the king of Judah assisting him)].


###### Daniel 11:24

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:24](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:24)


בְּשַׁלְוָ֞ה וּבְמִשְׁמַנֵּ֣י מְדִינָה֮ יָבוֹא֒ וְעָשָׂ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־עָשׂ֤וּ אֲבֹתָיו֙ וַאֲב֣וֹת אֲבֹתָ֔יו בִּזָּ֧ה וְשָׁלָ֛ל וּרְכ֖וּשׁ לָהֶ֣ם יִבְז֑וֹר וְעַ֧ל מִבְצָרִ֛ים יְחַשֵּׁ֥ב מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֖יו וְעַד־עֵֽת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He shall enter without difficulty even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, or his fathers’ fathers; he shall scatter among them prey, and spoil, and riches: and he shall devise schemes against the strongholds, but only for a time.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Quietly [(and deceitfully)] and into the fats of the land shall he come, and he will do what his fathers and his fathers' fathers had not done. And spoils and wealth shall he spread among them [(among all who would take his yoke upon them)]. And over fortresses will he plot his designs [(placing his commanders over them)] until the time [(when all is under his domination)].


###### Daniel 11:25

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:25](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:25)


וְיָעֵר֩ כֹּח֨וֹ וּלְבָב֜וֹ עַל־מֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֘גֶב֮ בְּחַ֣יִל גָּדוֹל֒ וּמֶ֣לֶךְ הַנֶּ֗גֶב יִתְגָּרֶה֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה בְּחַֽיִל־גָּד֥וֹל וְעָצ֖וּם עַד־מְאֹ֑ד וְלֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֔ד כִּֽי־יַחְשְׁב֥וּ עָלָ֖יו מַחֲשָׁבֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall devise schemes against him.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he will rouse up his strength and his heart against the king of the south with a great army. And the king of the south will wage war with a great and extremely powerful army, but he will not prevail. For they will have plotted designs against him [(by bribing his retainers)].


###### Daniel 11:26

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:26](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:26)


וְאֹכְלֵ֧י פַת־בָּג֛וֹ יִשְׁבְּר֖וּהוּ וְחֵיל֣וֹ יִשְׁט֑וֹף וְנָפְל֖וּ חֲלָלִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For those who eat his food shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the eaters of his pathbag [viz. 1:5] will break him, and he [(the king of the north)] will sweep away his army, and many slain will fall.


###### Daniel 11:27

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:27](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:27)


וּשְׁנֵיהֶ֤ם הַמְּלָכִים֙ לְבָבָ֣ם לְמֵרָ֔ע וְעַל־שֻׁלְחָ֥ן אֶחָ֖ד כָּזָ֣ב יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ וְלֹ֣א תִצְלָ֔ח כִּי־ע֥וֹד קֵ֖ץ לַמּוֹעֵֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And both these kings’ hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for the end is yet to come at the time appointed.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the two kings [(the Roman king and the "maker of the covenant," Hyrcanus, who joined him in order to receive his aid against his brother Aristobulus, reigning in Jerusalem)] — their hearts will be [joined] to do evil [against your people, Judah]. And against one "table" [(the kingdom of Aristobulus)] will they speak deceit. But it [(their counsel)] will not prevail, for there is yet [time remaining] for the end [i.e., the destruction] appointed [for them (viz. 9:25)].


###### Daniel 11:28

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:28](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:28)


וְיָשֹׁ֤ב אַרְצוֹ֙ בִּרְכ֣וּשׁ גָּד֔וֹל וּלְבָב֖וֹ עַל־בְּרִ֣ית קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְעָשָׂ֖ה וְשָׁ֥ב לְאַרְצֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart shall be set against the holy covenant; and he shall work his will, and return to his own land.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he [(the king of Rome)] will return to his land [(from his campaign against the king of the south)] with great wealth. And his heart will [plot to break] the sacred covenant [with Israel]. And he will prevail and return to his land.


###### Daniel 11:29

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:29](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:29)


לַמּוֹעֵ֥ד יָשׁ֖וּב וּבָ֣א בַנֶּ֑גֶב וְלֹֽא־תִהְיֶ֥ה כָרִאשֹׁנָ֖ה וְכָאַחֲרוֹנָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
At the time appointed he shall return, and come towards the south; but it shall not be at the latter time as it was at the former.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
After some time, he will return and come to the south, but [his coming] will not be [as successful] as the first [viz. 11:7] or the last [28].


###### Daniel 11:30

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:30](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:30)


וּבָ֨אוּ ב֜וֹ צִיִּ֤ים כִּתִּים֙ וְנִכְאָ֔ה וְשָׁ֛ב וְזָעַ֥ם עַל־בְּרִֽית־ק֖וֹדֶשׁ וְעָשָׂ֑ה וְשָׁ֣ב וְיָבֵ֔ן עַל־עֹזְבֵ֖י בְּרִ֥ית קֹֽדֶשׁ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
For ships of Kittim shall come against him: therefore he shall lose heart and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant, and do his will; he shall even return, and have an understanding with those who forsake the holy covenant.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And there will come against him factions and troops [(of rebellious Romans)], and he will be weakened, and he will return [to his land] in wrath over the sacred covenant [(that he made with Israel, resolved to break it)]. And he will prevail and return and reflect upon the forsakers of the sacred covenant [(between themselves and the L-rd, and take heart therefrom that he will succeed in breaking his covenant with them.)]


###### Daniel 11:31

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:31](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:31)


וּזְרֹעִ֖ים מִמֶּ֣נּוּ יַעֲמֹ֑דוּ וְחִלְּל֞וּ הַמִּקְדָּ֤שׁ הַמָּעוֹז֙ וְהֵסִ֣ירוּ הַתָּמִ֔יד וְנָתְנ֖וּ הַשִּׁקּ֥וּץ מְשֹׁמֵֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And arms shall stand up on his part, and they shall profane sanctuary and fortress, and shall take away the daily sacrifice, and they shall set up the abomination that makes desolate.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And forces will arise from him [(He will send his chiefs and warriors to Jerusalem)], and they will desecrate the abode of the sanctuary. And they will abolish the continual [burnt-offering], and they will install "the mute abomination."


###### Daniel 11:32

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:32](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:32)


וּמַרְשִׁיעֵ֣י בְרִ֔ית יַחֲנִ֖יף בַּחֲלַקּ֑וֹת וְעַ֛ם יֹדְעֵ֥י אֱלֹהָ֖יו יַחֲזִ֥קוּ וְעָשֽׂוּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he seduce by flatteries: but the people who know their God shall be strong, and prevail.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the forsakers of the covenant [(with their fellow-Jews)] he will flatter with smoothness; but the people who know their G-d will persist [(in their belief)] and carry on.


###### Daniel 11:33

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:33](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:33)


וּמַשְׂכִּ֣ילֵי עָ֔ם יָבִ֖ינוּ לָֽרַבִּ֑ים וְנִכְשְׁל֞וּ בְּחֶ֧רֶב וּבְלֶהָבָ֛ה בִּשְׁבִ֥י וּבְבִזָּ֖ה יָמִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And they who understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, some days.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the enlighteners of the people [i.e., the Torah sages] will propound (it) to the many, and they will "stumble" [(in their exile)] by sword, flame, captivity, and plunder for [many] days.


###### Daniel 11:34

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:34](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:34)


וּבְהִכָּ֣שְׁלָ֔ם יֵעָזְר֖וּ עֵ֣זֶר מְעָ֑ט וְנִלְו֧וּ עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם רַבִּ֖ים בַּחֲלַקְלַקּֽוֹת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Now when they shall fall, they shall receive a little help: but many shall join themselves to them with flatteries.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And in their stumbling, they will be assisted somewhat [(by bribing the foe)], but many will join them because of their "smoothnesses."


###### Daniel 11:35

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:35](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:35)


וּמִן־הַמַּשְׂכִּילִ֣ים יִכָּֽשְׁל֗וּ לִצְר֥וֹף בָּהֶ֛ם וּלְבָרֵ֥ר וְלַלְבֵּ֖ן עַד־עֵ֣ת קֵ֑ץ כִּי־ע֖וֹד לַמּוֹעֵֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And some of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to refine, and to make them white, even to the time of the end: because it is yet for the time appointed.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And [some] of the enlightened ones will stumble [in attempting] to decipher them [(the times given for the redemption)] and to clarify and elucidate [them], until the time of the end [of the exile]; for [much time] yet remains until the appointed time.


###### Daniel 11:36

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:36](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:36)


וְעָשָׂ֨ה כִרְצֹנ֜וֹ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְיִתְרוֹמֵ֤ם וְיִתְגַּדֵּל֙ עַל־כׇּל־אֵ֔ל וְעַל֙ אֵ֣ל אֵלִ֔ים יְדַבֵּ֖ר נִפְלָא֑וֹת וְהִצְלִ֙יחַ֙ עַד־כָּ֣לָה זַ֔עַם כִּ֥י נֶחֱרָצָ֖ה נֶעֱשָֽׂתָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak astonishing things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that which is determined shall be done.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the king [of Rome] will do as he wills, and he will be exalted and aggrandized over all the mighty ones. And against the Mighty of the mighty he will "speak wonders" [i.e., he will spout blasphemies.] And he will succeed until the wrath [of the L-rd against Israel] ends, when His decree has been executed.


###### Daniel 11:37

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:37](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Daniel/r/11:37)

# Ezra

עזרא

Link: [https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra)

לאחר עשרות שנות גלות בית המקדש נבנה מחדש ועזרא הסופר מוביל תחייה רוחנית.

Rebuilding the Temple after decades of exile and religious revival led by Ezra the scribe.

## Chapter 1

###### Ezra 1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:1)


וּבִשְׁנַ֣ת אַחַ֗ת לְכ֙וֹרֶשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס לִכְל֥וֹת דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה מִפִּ֣י יִרְמְיָ֑ה הֵעִ֣יר יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶת־ר֙וּחַ֙ כֹּ֣רֶשׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־פָּרַ֔ס וַיַּֽעֲבֶר־קוֹל֙ בְּכׇל־מַלְכוּת֔וֹ וְגַם־בְּמִכְתָּ֖ב לֵאמֹֽר׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Now in the first year of Koresh king of Paras, that the word of the Lord by the mouth of Yirmeya might be fulfilled, the Lord stirred up the spirit of Koresh king of Paras, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And in the first year of Koresh, king of Paras, at the consummation of the word of the L-rd by the mouth of Jeremiah [viz. Jeremiah 29:10], the L-rd roused the spirit [i.e., the will] of Koresh, king of Paras, and he proclaimed throughout his kingdom, and [he issued the proclamation] in writing, too:


###### Ezra 1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:2)


כֹּ֣ה אָמַ֗ר כֹּ֚רֶשׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס כֹּ֚ל מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ נָ֣תַן לִ֔י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְהֽוּא־פָקַ֤ד עָלַי֙ לִבְנֽוֹת־ל֣וֹ בַ֔יִת בִּירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּֽיהוּדָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Thus says Koresh king of Paras, The Lord God of heaven has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has charged me to build him a house at Yerushalayim, which is in Yehuda.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
"Thus says Koresh, king of Paras: All the kingdoms of the earth have been given me by the L-rd, the G-d of the heavens. And He has commanded me [(by Isaiah, the prophet, viz. Isaiah 44:28 and 45:1)] to build Him a house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.


###### Ezra 1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:3)


מִֽי־בָכֶ֣ם מִכׇּל־עַמּ֗וֹ יְהִ֤י אֱלֹהָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וְיַ֕עַל לִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּיהוּדָ֑ה וְיִ֗בֶן אֶת־בֵּ֤ית יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל ה֥וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Whoever is among you of all his people, let his God be with him, and let him go up to Yerushalayim, which is in Yehuda, and build the house of the Lord God of Yisra᾽el; (he is the God,) which is in Yerushalayim.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Whoever of you is [(one)] of all his people, may his G-d be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah. And let him build the house of the L-rd, the G-d of Israel. He is the G-d who is in Jerusalem.


###### Ezra 1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:4)


וְכׇל־הַנִּשְׁאָ֗ר מִֽכׇּל־הַמְּקֹמוֹת֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר ה֣וּא גָֽר־שָׁם֒ יְנַשְּׂא֙וּהוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י מְקֹמ֔וֹ בְּכֶ֥סֶף וּבְזָהָ֖ב וּבִרְכ֣וּשׁ וּבִבְהֵמָ֑ה עִ֨ם־הַנְּדָבָ֔ה לְבֵ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And whoever remains in any place where he sojourns, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, besides the freewill offering for the house of God that is in Yerushalayim.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And every [Jew] who remains [(in his place)] of all the places where he may live, [lacking the wherewithal to go up to Jerusalem)], the people of his place [(even the non-Jews)] shall bestow upon him silver, gold, goods, and beasts with [their] gift to the house of G-d which is in Jerusalem."


###### Ezra 1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:5)


וַיָּק֜וּמוּ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֗וֹת לִֽיהוּדָה֙ וּבִנְיָמִ֔ן וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֑ם לְכֹ֨ל הֵעִ֤יר הָאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־רוּח֔וֹ לַעֲל֣וֹת לִבְנ֔וֹת אֶת־בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then rose up the chiefs of the fathers’ houses of Yehuda and Binyamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit God had stirred to go up to build the house of the Lord which is in Yerushalayim.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And there rose up the heads of the fathers' [houses] of [the tribes of] Judah and Benjamin and the priests and the Levites, with all whose spirit G-d had roused to go up to build the house of the L-rd in Jerusalem.


###### Ezra 1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:6)


וְכׇל־סְבִיבֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ חִזְּק֣וּ בִֽידֵיהֶ֔ם בִּכְלֵי־כֶ֧סֶף בַּזָּהָ֛ב בָּרְכ֥וּשׁ וּבַבְּהֵמָ֖ה וּבַמִּגְדָּנ֑וֹת לְבַ֖ד עַל־כׇּל־הִתְנַדֵּֽב׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And all they who were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, besides all that was willingly offered.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And all [the peoples] around them strengthened them with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, with beasts, and with confections, aside from all their donations [(to the Temple itself)].


###### Ezra 1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:7)


וְהַמֶּ֣לֶךְ כּ֔וֹרֶשׁ הוֹצִ֖יא אֶת־כְּלֵ֣י בֵית־יְהֹוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצִ֤יא נְבֽוּכַדְנֶצַּר֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖ם בְּבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהָֽיו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Also Koresh the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the Lord, which Nevukhadneżżar had brought out of Yerushalayim, and had put them in the house of his gods;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And King Koresh brought out all the vessels of the house of the L-rd which Nevuchadnezzar had taken out from Jerusalem and had placed in the house of his god.


###### Ezra 1:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:8)


וַיּֽוֹצִיאֵ֗ם כּ֚וֹרֶשׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ פָּרַ֔ס עַל־יַ֖ד מִתְרְדָ֣ת הַגִּזְבָּ֑ר וַֽיִּסְפְּרֵם֙ לְשֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֔ר הַנָּשִׂ֖יא לִיהוּדָֽה׃{ס}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
those did Koresh king of Paras bring out by the hand of Mitredat the treasurer, and counted them out to Sheshbażżar, the prince of Yehuda.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Koresh, king of Paras, had them brought out by Mithradath the treasurer, and he counted them out to Sheshbatzar [(Daniel)], the prince of Judah.


###### Ezra 1:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:9)


וְאֵ֖לֶּה מִסְפָּרָ֑ם אֲגַרְטְלֵ֨י זָהָ֜ב שְׁלֹשִׁ֗ים אֲגַרְטְלֵי־כֶ֙סֶף֙ אָ֔לֶף מַחֲלָפִ֖ים תִּשְׁעָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃{ס}

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Ezra 1:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:10)


כְּפוֹרֵ֤י זָהָב֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֔ים כְּפ֤וֹרֵי כֶ֙סֶף֙ מִשְׁנִ֔ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וַעֲשָׂרָ֑ה כֵּלִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
thirty bowls of gold, silver bowls of a second sort four hundred and ten, and other vessels a thousand.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Ezra 1:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/1:11)


כׇּל־כֵּלִים֙ לַזָּהָ֣ב וְלַכֶּ֔סֶף חֲמֵ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וְאַרְבַּ֣ע מֵא֑וֹת הַכֹּ֞ל הֶעֱלָ֣ה שֵׁשְׁבַּצַּ֗ר עִ֚ם הֵעָל֣וֹת הַגּוֹלָ֔ה מִבָּבֶ֖ל לִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand four hundred. All these did Sheshbażżar bring, when the exiles were brought up from Bavel to Yerushalayim.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
All the vessels of gold and silver [(all told, counted separately or not)], five thousand and four hundred — all were brought up by Sheshbatzar with the going up of the exile from Bavel to Jerusalem.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And these are the men of the land [(Eretz Yisrael)] who went up from the captivity of the exile, which Nevuchadnezzar king of Bavel had exiled to Bavel, and who [now] returned to Jerusalem. And (those of) Judah returned, each to his city,

## Chapter 3

###### Ezra 3:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/3:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/3:1)


וַיִּגַּע֙ הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֶּעָרִ֑ים{ס}וַיֵּאָסְפ֥וּ הָעָ֛ם כְּאִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃{ס}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Yisra᾽el were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Yerushalayim.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the seventh month [(Tishrei)] arrived, with the children of Israel in [their] cities, and the people gathered as one man to Jerusalem.


###### Ezra 3:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/3:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/3:2)


וַיָּ֩קׇם֩ יֵשׁ֨וּעַ בֶּן־יֽוֹצָדָ֜ק וְאֶחָ֣יו הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וּזְרֻבָּבֶ֤ל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל֙ וְאֶחָ֔יו וַיִּבְנ֕וּ אֶת־מִזְבַּ֖ח אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְהַעֲל֤וֹת עָלָיו֙ עֹל֔וֹת כַּכָּת֕וּב בְּתוֹרַ֖ת מֹשֶׁ֥ה אִישׁ־הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then stood up Yeshua the son of Yożadaq, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbavel the son of She᾽alti᾽el, and his brethren, and they built the altar of the God of Yisra᾽el, to offer burnt offerings upon it, as it is written in the Tora of Moshe the man of God.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Yeshua and his brother priests arose, and Zerubavel the son of She'altiel and his brothers, and they built the altar of the G-d of Israel to sacrifice burnt-offerings thereon, as prescribed in the Torah of Moses, the man of G-d.


###### Ezra 3:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/3:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/3:3)


וַיָּכִ֤ינוּ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ עַל־מְכ֣וֹנֹתָ֔יו כִּ֚י בְּאֵימָ֣ה עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם מֵעַמֵּ֖י הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת (ויעל) [וַיַּעֲל֨וּ] עָלָ֤יו עֹלוֹת֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה עֹל֖וֹת לַבֹּ֥קֶר וְלָעָֽרֶב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And they set the altar upon its bases; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings upon it to the Lord, burnt offerings morning and evening.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they set the altar on its foundations [(to show that they had royal sanction)], for they were in fear of the peoples of the lands [(lest they libel them as rebels)]. And they sacrificed upon it burnt-offerings to the L-rd [(the continual burnt-offerings)] in the morning and in the evening.


###### Ezra 3:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/3:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/3:4)


וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת־חַ֥ג הַסֻּכּ֖וֹת כַּכָּת֑וּב וְעֹלַ֨ת י֤וֹם בְּיוֹם֙ בְּמִסְפָּ֔ר כְּמִשְׁפַּ֖ט דְּבַר־י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And they kept the feast of booths, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the prescribed form, as the duty of every day required;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they observed the festival of Succoth as prescribed, and (they offered) the sacrifice of the day in its day, in (its) number, as prescribed, the thing [i.e., the sacrifice] of the day in its day.


###### Ezra 3:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/3:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/3:5)


וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵ֞ן עֹלַ֤ת תָּמִיד֙ וְלֶ֣חֳדָשִׁ֔ים וּלְכׇל־מוֹעֲדֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה הַמְקֻדָּשִׁ֑ים וּלְכֹ֛ל מִתְנַדֵּ֥ב נְדָבָ֖ה לַיהֹוָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and afterwards they offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the sacred appointed seasons of the Lord, and on behalf of everyone who willingly offered a free will offering to the Lord.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And after that, (they offered) continual sacrifices [every day, morning and evening], and the offerings of the New Moon, and the sacrifices of all the (other) festivals, and (the sacrifices of) all those who would donate an offering to the L-rd.


###### Ezra 3:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/3:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/3:6)


מִיּ֤וֹם אֶחָד֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י הֵחֵ֕לּוּ לְהַעֲל֥וֹת עֹל֖וֹת לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְהֵיכַ֥ל יְהֹוָ֖ה לֹ֥א יֻסָּֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
From the first day of the seventh month they began to offer burnt offerings to the Lord. But the foundation of the temple of the Lord was not yet laid.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
From the first day of the seventh month they began to sacrifice burnt-offerings to the L-rd, though the foundation of the sanctuary had not yet been laid.


###### Ezra 3:7

###### Ezra 9:1

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Ezra 9:2

## Chapter 10

###### Ezra 10:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/10:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/10:1)


וּכְהִתְפַּלֵּ֤ל עֶזְרָא֙ וּכְהִתְוַדֹּת֔וֹ בֹּכֶה֙ וּמִתְנַפֵּ֔ל לִפְנֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים נִקְבְּצוּ֩ אֵלָ֨יו מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֜ל קָהָ֣ל רַב־מְאֹ֗ד אֲנָשִׁ֤ים וְנָשִׁים֙ וִֽילָדִ֔ים כִּֽי־בָכ֥וּ הָעָ֖ם הַרְבֵּה־בֶֽכֶה׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Ezra 10:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/10:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/10:2)


וַיַּ֩עַן֩ שְׁכַנְיָ֨ה בֶן־יְחִיאֵ֜ל מִבְּנֵ֤י (עולם) [עֵילָם֙] וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְעֶזְרָ֔א אֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ מָעַ֣לְנוּ בֵאלֹהֵ֔ינוּ וַנֹּ֛שֶׁב נָשִׁ֥ים נׇכְרִיּ֖וֹת מֵעַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וְעַתָּ֛ה יֵשׁ־מִקְוֶ֥ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַל־זֹֽאת׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And Shekhanya the son of Yeĥi᾽el, one of the sons of ῾Elam, answered and said to ῾Ezra, We have trespassed against our God, and have taken alien women of the peoples of the land: yet now there is hope in Yisra᾽el concerning this thing.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Shechanyah the son of Yechiel of the sons of Eilam called out and said to Ezra: We have been faithless to our G-d and have taken into our houses foreign women of the peoples of the land. But now, there is hope for Israel for this [i.e., We can send away these women and the children born of them.]


###### Ezra 10:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/10:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Ezra/r/10:3)


וְעַתָּ֣ה נִֽכְרׇת־בְּרִ֣ית לֵ֠אלֹהֵ֠ינוּ לְהוֹצִ֨יא כׇל־נָשִׁ֜ים וְהַנּוֹלָ֤ד מֵהֶם֙ בַּעֲצַ֣ת אֲדֹנָ֔י וְהַחֲרֵדִ֖ים בְּמִצְוַ֣ת אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְכַתּוֹרָ֖ה יֵעָשֶֽׂה׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Now therefore let us make a covenant with our God to put away all such women, and such as are born of them, according to the counsel of my lord, and of those who tremble at the commandment of our God; and let it be done according to the Tora.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And now, let us make a covenant with our G-d to send out all the [foreign] women and those born to them, by the will of the L-rd. And those who are zealous for the mitzvah of our G-d [will do so]; and he will be acting in accordance with the Torah.

# Nehemiah

נחמיה

Link: [https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah)

שיקום חומות ירושלים ונכונות העם לקבל עליו את שמירת המצוות.

Rebuilding Jerusalem’s walls and the nation’s commitment to observe the commandments.

Sections: Chapter-Verse

Location: Tanakh/Writings

Originally from [Sefaria](https://www.sefaria.org) via [TorahLM.org](https://torahlm.org) — see [licensing](https://torahlm.org/sefaria_license).

Version (He): Miqra according to the Masorah (Segments: 405, License: CC-BY-SA)

Versions (En):
  - The Koren Jerusalem Bible (Segments: 405, License: CC-BY-NC)
  - The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein (Segments: 405, License: CC-BY)


## Chapter 1

###### Nehemiah 1:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:1)


דִּבְרֵ֥י נְחֶמְיָ֖ה בֶּן־חֲכַלְיָ֑ה וַיְהִ֤י בְחֹֽדֶשׁ־כִּסְלֵו֙ שְׁנַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וַאֲנִ֥י הָיִ֖יתִי בְּשׁוּשַׁ֥ן הַבִּירָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
The words of Neĥemya the son of Ḥakhalya. And it came to pass in the month Kislev, in the twentieth year, as I was in Shushan the capital,


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
The words [written] by Nechemiah the son of Chachalyah: And it was in the month of Kislev, the twentieth year [of the reign of Artachshast (Darius)], and I was in Shushan, the capital city.


###### Nehemiah 1:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:2)


וַיָּבֹ֨א חֲנָ֜נִי אֶחָ֧ד מֵאַחַ֛י ה֥וּא וַאֲנָשִׁ֖ים מִֽיהוּדָ֑ה וָאֶשְׁאָלֵ֞ם עַל־הַיְּהוּדִ֧ים הַפְּלֵיטָ֛ה אֲשֶֽׁר־נִשְׁאֲר֥וּ מִן־הַשֶּׁ֖בִי וְעַל־יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
that Ḥanani, one of my brothers, came, he and certain men of Yehuda; and I asked them concerning the Jews who had escaped, who were left of the captivity, and concerning Yerushalayim.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Chanani, one of my friends, he and [other] men came from Judah, and I inquired of them about the remnant of the Jews, who were left [in Jerusalem] from the [Babylonian] captivity, and about Jerusalem.


###### Nehemiah 1:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:3)


וַיֹּאמְרוּ֮ לִי֒ הַֽנִּשְׁאָרִ֞ים אֲשֶֽׁר־נִשְׁאֲר֤וּ מִן־הַשְּׁבִי֙ שָׁ֣ם בַּמְּדִינָ֔ה בְּרָעָ֥ה גְדֹלָ֖ה וּבְחֶרְפָּ֑ה וְחוֹמַ֤ת יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ מְפֹרָ֔צֶת וּשְׁעָרֶ֖יהָ נִצְּת֥וּ בָאֵֽשׁ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And they said to me, The remnant who are left of the captivity there in the province suffer much hardship and insult: and the wall of Yerushalayim is broken down, and its gates are burned with fire.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they answered me [(in the order of my inquiries)]: The remnant who are left of the captivity there in the land are in dire straits and in shame. And the wall of Jerusalem is breached, and its gates burnt in fire [(the Jews having restored only the Temple, but not the city walls)].


###### Nehemiah 1:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:4)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And it was, when I heard these words, I sat and wept, and I mourned for [several] days, and I fasted and prayed before the G-d of Heaven.


###### Nehemiah 1:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:5)

###### Nehemiah 1:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:6)

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
let Thy ear now be attentive, and Thy eyes open, that Thou mayst hear the prayer of Thy servant, which I pray before Thee now day and night, for the children of Yisra᾽el Thy servants, and I will confess the sins of the children of Yisra᾽el which we have sinned against Thee: both I and my father’s house have sinned.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Nehemiah 1:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:7)


חֲבֹ֖ל חָבַ֣לְנוּ לָ֑ךְ וְלֹא־שָׁמַ֣רְנוּ אֶת־הַמִּצְוֺ֗ת וְאֶת־הַֽחֻקִּים֙ וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֖יתָ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדֶּֽךָ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Nehemiah 1:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:8)


זְכׇר־נָא֙ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּ֛יתָ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֥ה עַבְדְּךָ֖ לֵאמֹ֑ר אַתֶּ֣ם תִּמְעָ֔לוּ אֲנִ֕י אָפִ֥יץ אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּעַמִּֽים׃

###### Nehemiah 1:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:9)


וְשַׁבְתֶּ֣ם אֵלַ֔י וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ מִצְוֺתַ֔י וַעֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑ם אִם־יִהְיֶ֨ה נִֽדַּחֲכֶ֜ם בִּקְצֵ֤ה הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ מִשָּׁ֣ם אֲקַבְּצֵ֔ם (והבואתים) [וַהֲבִֽיאוֹתִים֙] אֶל־הַמָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחַ֔רְתִּי לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן אֶת־שְׁמִ֖י שָֽׁם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
but if you turn to me, and keep my commandments, and do them; though your outcasts be at the utmost parts of heaven, from there will I gather them, and I will bring them to the place which I have chosen to set my name there.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
but if you return to Me, and keep My mitzvoth and do them, (even) if your cast-off ones be in the end of the heavens, from there I will gather them and bring them to the place wherein I have chosen to repose My name. [(viz. Deuteronomy 30:4)].


###### Nehemiah 1:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:10)


וְהֵ֥ם עֲבָדֶ֖יךָ וְעַמֶּ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּדִ֙יתָ֙ בְּכֹחֲךָ֣ הַגָּד֔וֹל וּבְיָדְךָ֖ הַחֲזָקָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Now these are Thy servants and Thy people, whom Thou hast redeemed by Thy great power, and by Thy strong hand.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And they are Your servants and Your people that You have redeemed with Your great strength and Your strong hand.


###### Nehemiah 1:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/1:11)


אָנָּ֣א אֲדֹנָ֗י תְּהִ֣י נָ֣א אׇזְנְךָֽ־קַ֠שֶּׁ֠בֶת אֶל־תְּפִלַּ֨ת עַבְדְּךָ֜ וְאֶל־תְּפִלַּ֣ת עֲבָדֶ֗יךָ הַֽחֲפֵצִים֙ לְיִרְאָ֣ה אֶת־שְׁמֶ֔ךָ וְהַצְלִֽיחָה־נָּ֤א לְעַבְדְּךָ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם וּתְנֵ֣הוּ לְרַחֲמִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י הָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֶּ֑ה וַאֲנִ֛י הָיִ֥יתִי מַשְׁקֶ֖ה לַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
O Lord, I pray Thee, let now Thy ear be attentive to the prayer of Thy servant, and to the prayer of Thy servants, who delight to fear Thy name: and prosper, I pray Thee, Thy servant this day, and grant him mercy in the sight of this man. For I was the king’s cupbearer.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I beseech you, O L-rd, let Your ear be inclined to the prayer of Your servant [(himself)] and to the prayer of Your servants [(Israel)], who desire to fear Your name. And prosper, I pray You, Your servant this day, and render him [(an object of)] compassion before this man [(Darius)]. (And I was the king's cupbearer.)



## Chapter 2

###### Nehemiah 2:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:1)


וַיְהִ֣י**׀** בְּחֹ֣דֶשׁ נִיסָ֗ן שְׁנַ֥ת עֶשְׂרִ֛ים לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁ֥סְתְּא הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ יַ֣יִן לְפָנָ֑יו וָאֶשָּׂ֤א אֶת־הַיַּ֙יִן֙ וָאֶתְּנָ֣ה לַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְלֹא־הָיִ֥יתִי רַ֖ע לְפָנָֽיו׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And it came to pass in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaĥshasta the king, that wine was before him: and I took up the wine, and gave it to the king. Now I had not been beforetime sad in his presence.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And it was, in the month of Nissan, the twentieth year of Artachshast [(Darius)] the king, [they brought] wine before him [(in the courtyard)] and I took [(the cup of wine)] and gave it to the king, and I had [never before] been downcast before him [(but always cheerful)].


###### Nehemiah 2:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:2)


וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ לִ֨י הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ מַדּ֣וּעַ**׀** פָּנֶ֣יךָ רָעִ֗ים וְאַתָּה֙ אֵֽינְךָ֣ חוֹלֶ֔ה אֵ֣ין זֶ֔ה כִּי־אִ֖ם רֹ֣עַֽ לֵ֑ב וָאִירָ֖א הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Wherefore the king said to me, Why is thy face sad, seeing thou art not sick? this is nothing else but sorrow of heart. Then I was very much afraid,


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the king said to me: Why are you downcast? This must be badness of heart [i.e., you must be plotting to poison me with the wine]; and I feared greatly [(for my life)].


###### Nehemiah 2:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:3)


וָאֹמַ֣ר לַמֶּ֔לֶךְ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יִחְיֶ֑ה מַדּ֜וּעַ לֹא־יֵרְע֣וּ פָנַ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָעִ֜יר בֵּית־קִבְר֤וֹת אֲבֹתַי֙ חֲרֵבָ֔ה וּשְׁעָרֶ֖יהָ אֻכְּל֥וּ בָאֵֽשׁ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and I said to the king, Let the king live for ever: why should not my face be sad, when the city, the place of the tombs of my ancestors lies waste, and its gates are consumed with fire?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I said to the king: May the king live forever. Why should I not be downcast when the city of the graves of my fathers [(Jerusalem)] is in ruins, and her gates consumed with fire?


###### Nehemiah 2:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:4)


וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לִי֙ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ עַל־מַה־זֶּ֖ה אַתָּ֣ה מְבַקֵּ֑שׁ וָֽאֶתְפַּלֵּ֔ל אֶל־אֱלֹהֵ֖י הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then the king said to me, For what dost thou make request? So I prayed to the God of heaven.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the king said: What is your request [(and I shall grant it)], and I [(Nechemiah)] prayed before the G-d of heaven [(saying: So be it before the G-d of heaven that you [the king] grant my request)].


###### Nehemiah 2:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:5)


וָאֹמַ֣ר לַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אִם־עַל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ ט֔וֹב וְאִם־יִיטַ֥ב עַבְדְּךָ֖ לְפָנֶ֑יךָ אֲשֶׁ֧ר תִּשְׁלָחֵ֣נִי אֶל־יְהוּדָ֗ה אֶל־עִ֛יר קִבְר֥וֹת אֲבֹתַ֖י וְאֶבְנֶֽנָּה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And I said to the king, If it please the king, and if thy servant have found favour in thy sight that thou wouldst send me to Yehuda, to the city of the graves of my ancestors, that I may rebuild it.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I said to the king: If it pleases the king, and if your servant is worthy in your eyes, [my request is] that you send me to Judah, to the city of the graves of my fathers and that I rebuild it.


###### Nehemiah 2:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:6)


וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ לִ֨י הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ וְהַשֵּׁגַ֣ל**׀** יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת אֶצְל֗וֹ עַד־מָתַ֛י יִהְיֶ֥ה מַֽהֲלָכְךָ֖ וּמָתַ֣י תָּשׁ֑וּב וַיִּיטַ֤ב לִפְנֵֽי־הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ וַיִּשְׁלָחֵ֔נִי וָֽאֶתְּנָ֥ה ל֖וֹ זְמָֽן׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the king said to me, (the queen also sitting by him,) For how long shall thy journey be? and when wilt thou return? So it pleased the king to send me; and I set him a time.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the king said to me (the queen sitting at his side): When do you wish to go and when will you return? And it [(my request)] was good before the king, and he sent me [i.e., he permitted me to go], and I gave him a time [(for my return)].


###### Nehemiah 2:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:7)


וָאוֹמַר֮ לַמֶּ֒לֶךְ֒ אִם־עַל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ ט֔וֹב אִגְּרוֹת֙ יִתְּנוּ־לִ֔י עַֽל־פַּחֲו֖וֹת עֵ֣בֶר הַנָּהָ֑ר אֲשֶׁר֙ יַעֲבִיר֔וּנִי עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־אָב֖וֹא אֶל־יְהוּדָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Moreover I said to the king, If it please the king, let letters be given me to the governors beyond the river, that they may let me pass through until I come into Yehuda;


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I said to the king: If it pleases the king, let them [(your scribes)] give me letters [of authorization from you] to the governors across the river that they escort me [(in safety)] until I come to [Jerusalem in] Judah.


###### Nehemiah 2:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:8)


וְאִגֶּ֡רֶת אֶל־אָסָף֩ שֹׁמֵ֨ר הַפַּרְדֵּ֜ס אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַמֶּ֗לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִתֶּן־לִ֣י עֵצִ֡ים לְ֠קָר֠וֹת אֶת־שַׁעֲרֵ֨י הַבִּירָ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־לַבַּ֙יִת֙ וּלְחוֹמַ֣ת הָעִ֔יר וְלַבַּ֖יִת אֲשֶׁר־אָב֣וֹא אֵלָ֑יו וַיִּתֶּן־לִ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ כְּיַד־אֱלֹהַ֖י הַטּוֹבָ֥ה עָלָֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
and a letter to Asaf the keeper of the king’s forest, that he may give me timber to make beams for the gates of the fortress of the temple, and for the wall of the city, and for the house that I shall enter into. And the king granted me, according to the good hand of my God upon me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And [I request that] you send a letter to Asaf, keeper of the king's forests, that he give me timber for roofing the gates of the Temple walls and for the city walls and for the house in which I will live.


###### Nehemiah 2:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:9)


וָֽאָב֗וֹא אֶֽל־פַּֽחֲווֹת֙ עֵ֣בֶר הַנָּהָ֔ר וָאֶתְּנָ֣ה לָהֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת אִגְּר֣וֹת הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח עִמִּי֙ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ שָׂ֥רֵי חַ֖יִל וּפָרָשִֽׁים׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I came to the governors across the river, and I gave them the king's letters, (and the king had sent with me officers and horsemen [to escort me]).


###### Nehemiah 2:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:10)


וַיִּשְׁמַ֞ע סַנְבַלַּ֣ט הַחֹרֹנִ֗י וְטֽוֹבִיָּה֙ הָעֶ֣בֶד הָֽעַמֹּנִ֔י וַיֵּ֥רַע לָהֶ֖ם רָעָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֣א אָדָ֔ם לְבַקֵּ֥שׁ טוֹבָ֖ה לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
When Sanvallat the Ḥoronite, and Toviyya the servant, the ῾Ammonite, heard of it, it displeased them greatly that there was come a man to seek the welfare of the children of Yisra᾽el.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And [when] Sanvalat the Choronite and Toviah, the Ammonite slave, heard [why I had come], it grieved them greatly that a man had come to seek the good of the children of Israel.


###### Nehemiah 2:11

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:11](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:11)


וָאָב֖וֹא אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וָאֱהִי־שָׁ֖ם יָמִ֥ים שְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
So I came to Yerushalayim, and was there three days.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I came to Jerusalem and I stayed there for three days.


###### Nehemiah 2:12

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:12](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:12)


וָאָק֣וּם**׀** לַ֗יְלָה אֲנִי֮ וַאֲנָשִׁ֣ים׀מְעַט֮ עִמִּי֒ וְלֹא־הִגַּ֣דְתִּי לְאָדָ֔ם מָ֗ה אֱלֹהַי֙ נֹתֵ֣ן אֶל־לִבִּ֔י לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת לִירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וּבְהֵמָה֙ אֵ֣ין עִמִּ֔י כִּ֚י אִם־הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י רֹכֵ֥ב בָּֽהּ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me; and I told no one what my God had put in my heart to do at Yerushalayim: nor was there any beast with me, save the beast that I rode upon.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I arose at night, I and a few men with me, and I told no one what my G-d had placed it in my heart to do with Jerusalem; and there were no beasts with me, but only the beast on which I rode [(so that they could leave without being detected and he could execute what he had in mind)].


###### Nehemiah 2:13

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:13](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:13)


וָאֵצְאָ֨ה בְשַֽׁעַר־הַגַּ֜יְא לַ֗יְלָה וְאֶל־פְּנֵי֙ עֵ֣ין הַתַּנִּ֔ין וְאֶל־שַׁ֖עַר הָאַשְׁפֹּ֑ת וָאֱהִ֨י שֹׂבֵ֜ר בְּחוֹמֹ֤ת יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ אֲשֶׁר־[הֵ֣ם׀פְּרוּצִ֔ים] (המפרוצים) וּשְׁעָרֶ֖יהָ אֻכְּל֥וּ בָאֵֽשׁ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon’s well, and to the dung gate, and viewed the walls of Yerushalayim, which were broken down, and its gates which had been destroyed by fire.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I went out at night [(with the few men who were with me)] through the Gate of the Valley towards Ein Tanin and to the Dung Gate [in the walls of the city], and I breached [(even more)] the walls of Jerusalem, which were [(already)] breached and whose gates had been consumed by fire.


###### Nehemiah 2:14

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:14](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:14)


וָאֶֽעֱבֹר֙ אֶל־שַׁ֣עַר הָעַ֔יִן וְאֶל־בְּרֵכַ֖ת הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְאֵין־מָק֥וֹם לַבְּהֵמָ֖ה לַעֲבֹ֥ר תַּחְתָּֽי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then I went on to the fountain gate and to the king’s pool: but there was no place for the beast that was under me to pass.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I [wished to] pass on to the Spring Gate and to the King's pool, but there was no room [(in those breaches)] for the beast under me to pass on.


###### Nehemiah 2:15

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:15](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:15)


וָאֱהִ֨י עֹלֶ֤ה בַנַּ֙חַל֙ לַ֔יְלָה וָאֱהִ֥י שֹׂבֵ֖ר בַּחוֹמָ֑ה וָאָשׁ֗וּב וָאָב֛וֹא בְּשַׁ֥עַר הַגַּ֖יְא וָאָשֽׁוּב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then I went up in the night by the wadi, and viewed the wall, and turned back, and entered by the gate of the valley, and so returned.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
So I went up the valley at night, breaking the wall [(with the men who were with me)], and I returned and came to the Gate of the Valley, and I returned [(whence I had come)].


###### Nehemiah 2:16

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:16](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:16)


וְהַסְּגָנִ֗ים לֹ֤א יָדְעוּ֙ אָ֣נָה הָלַ֔כְתִּי וּמָ֖ה אֲנִ֣י עֹשֶׂ֑ה וְלַיְּהוּדִ֨ים וְלַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים וְלַחֹרִ֣ים וְלַסְּגָנִ֗ים וּלְיֶ֙תֶר֙ עֹשֵׂ֣ה הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה עַד־כֵּ֖ן לֹ֥א הִגַּֽדְתִּי׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the rulers knew not where I had gone or what I had done; nor had I as yet told it to the Jews, or to the priests, or to the nobles, or to the rulers, or to the rest who did the work.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the [city] officers did not know where I had gone and what I had done, and I had not told (of it) until then to the Jews, the priests, the nobles, the officers, and the rest of the functionaries.


###### Nehemiah 2:17

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:17](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:17)


וָאוֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם אַתֶּ֤ם רֹאִים֙ הָרָעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲנַ֣חְנוּ בָ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ חֲרֵבָ֔ה וּשְׁעָרֶ֖יהָ נִצְּת֣וּ בָאֵ֑שׁ לְכ֗וּ וְנִבְנֶה֙ אֶת־חוֹמַ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וְלֹא־נִהְיֶ֥ה ע֖וֹד חֶרְפָּֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then said I to them, You see the distress that we are in, how Yerushalayim lies waste, and its gates are burned with fire: come and let us build up the wall of Yerushalayim, so that we no longer suffer insult.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And [(the next day)] I said to them: You see the evil in which we find ourselves, that Jerusalem is in ruins and its gates consumed in fire. Let us go and build the wall of Jerusalem and not be [reduced to] shame anymore.


###### Nehemiah 2:18

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:18](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:18)


וָאַגִּ֨יד לָהֶ֜ם אֶת־יַ֣ד אֱלֹהַ֗י אֲשֶׁר־הִיא֙ טוֹבָ֣ה עָלַ֔י וְאַף־דִּבְרֵ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽמַר־לִ֑י וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ נָק֣וּם וּבָנִ֔ינוּ וַיְחַזְּק֥וּ יְדֵיהֶ֖ם לַטּוֹבָֽה׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then I told them of the hand of my God which was good upon me; as also the king’s words that had spoken to me. And they said, Let us rise up and build. So they strengthened their hands for this good work.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I told them of the hand of my G-d upon me for the good [(i.e., His having granted me favor in the eyes of the king)], and also the words of the king that he had spoken to me. And they said: Let us arise and build! And they strengthened their hands for the good [i.e., for the building of the wall and the towers of the city.]


###### Nehemiah 2:19

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:19](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:19)


וַיִּשְׁמַע֩ סַנְבַלַּ֨ט הַחֹרֹנִ֜י וְטֹבִיָּ֣ה**׀** הָעֶ֣בֶד הָֽעַמּוֹנִ֗י וְגֶ֙שֶׁם֙ הָֽעַרְבִ֔י וַיַּלְעִ֣גוּ לָ֔נוּ וַיִּבְז֖וּ עָלֵ֑ינוּ וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ מָֽה־הַדָּבָ֤ר הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַתֶּ֣ם עֹשִׂ֔ים הַעַ֥ל הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אַתֶּ֥ם מֹרְדִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
But when Sanvallat the Ḥoronite, and Toviyya the servant, the ῾Ammonite, and Geshem the ῾Arvian heard it, they laughed us to scorn, and despised us, and said, What is this thing that you do? will you rebel against the king?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And Sanvalat the Choronite and Toviah the Ammonite slave and Geshem the Arab heard, and they mocked and scorned us, saying: What is this thing that you do? Would you rebel against the king!


###### Nehemiah 2:20

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:20](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/2:20)


וָאָשִׁ֨יב אוֹתָ֜ם דָּבָ֗ר וָאוֹמַ֤ר לָהֶם֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם ה֚וּא יַצְלִ֣יחַֽ לָ֔נוּ וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ עֲבָדָ֖יו נָק֣וּם וּבָנִ֑ינוּ וְלָכֶ֗ם אֵֽין־חֵ֧לֶק וּצְדָקָ֛ה וְזִכָּר֖וֹן בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Then I answered them, and said to them, The God of heaven, he will prosper us; therefore we his servants will arise and build: but you have no portion, or right, or memorial, in Yerushalayim.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I rejoined: The G-d of heaven, He will prosper us, and we, His servants, will arise and build. As for you, [what business do you have with building the city wall]? You have no share or righteousness or remembrance in Jerusalem!

וַיָּ֡קׇם אֶלְיָשִׁיב֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַגָּד֜וֹל וְאֶחָ֣יו הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וַיִּבְנוּ֙ אֶת־שַׁ֣עַר הַצֹּ֔אן הֵ֣מָּה קִדְּשׁ֔וּהוּ וַֽיַּעֲמִ֖ידוּ דַּלְתֹתָ֑יו וְעַד־מִגְדַּ֤ל הַמֵּאָה֙ קִדְּשׁ֔וּהוּ עַ֖ד מִגְדַּ֥ל חֲנַנְאֵֽל׃{ס}

And we [continued] building the wall, and when [the breaches of] half the wall had been filled, the heart of the people was [inspired] to do [i.e., to complete it].

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

## Chapter 5

###### Nehemiah 5:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/5:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/5:1)


וַתְּהִ֨י צַעֲקַ֥ת הָעָ֛ם וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם גְּדוֹלָ֑ה אֶל־אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם הַיְּהוּדִֽים׃

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Nehemiah 5:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/5:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/5:2)


וְיֵשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֹמְרִ֔ים בָּנֵ֥ינוּ וּבְנֹתֵ֖ינוּ אֲנַ֣חְנוּ רַבִּ֑ים וְנִקְחָ֥ה דָגָ֖ן וְנֹאכְלָ֥ה וְנִחְיֶֽה׃

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/5:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/5:3)

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Nehemiah 5:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/5:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/5:4)

There were also those who said, We have borrowed money for the king’s tribute, and that upon our lands and vineyards.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Nehemiah 5:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/5:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/5:5)


וְעַתָּ֗ה כִּבְשַׂ֤ר אַחֵ֙ינוּ֙ בְּשָׂרֵ֔נוּ כִּבְנֵיהֶ֖ם בָּנֵ֑ינוּ וְהִנֵּ֣ה אֲנַ֣חְנוּ כֹ֠בְשִׁ֠ים אֶת־בָּנֵ֨ינוּ וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵ֜ינוּ לַעֲבָדִ֗ים וְיֵ֨שׁ מִבְּנֹתֵ֤ינוּ נִכְבָּשׁוֹת֙ וְאֵ֣ין לְאֵ֣ל יָדֵ֔נוּ וּשְׂדֹתֵ֥ינוּ וּכְרָמֵ֖ינוּ לַאֲחֵרִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Yet now our flesh is as good as the flesh of our brethren, our children as good as their children: and, lo, we press our sons and our daughters into slavery, and some of our daughters are pressed into slavery already: nor is it in our power to redeem them; for other men have our lands and vineyards.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And now, [just as good] as our [rich] brothers' flesh is our flesh! [Just as good as] their sons are our sons! And, behold, we will have to impress our sons and daughters as slaves; and some of our daughters are [already] impressed, and we have not the wherewithal [to redeem them]. And our fields and vineyards [have already been given] to others [for food, and what shall we eat now!]


###### Nehemiah 5:6

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I was greatly troubled when I heard their cries and these things.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And my heart counseled me, and I quarreled with the nobles and the officers and said to them: You are exacting payment, each of his brother, [(by lending the poor in order to impress their sons and daughters and take their fields, their vineyards, and their houses.)] And I congregated against them a great crowd [(of the poor to cry out against them and shame them.)]


###### Nehemiah 5:8

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/5:8](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/5:8)


וָאֹמְרָ֣ה לָהֶ֗ם אֲנַ֣חְנוּ קָ֠נִ֠ינוּ אֶת־אַחֵ֨ינוּ הַיְּהוּדִ֜ים הַנִּמְכָּרִ֤ים לַגּוֹיִם֙ כְּדֵ֣י בָ֔נוּ וְגַם־אַתֶּ֛ם תִּמְכְּר֥וּ אֶת־אֲחֵיכֶ֖ם וְנִמְכְּרוּ־לָ֑נוּ וַֽיַּחֲרִ֔ישׁוּ וְלֹ֥א מָצְא֖וּ דָּבָֽר׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And I said to them, We after our ability have redeemed our brethren the Jews, who were sold to the heathen; and will you nevertheless sell your brethren? or shall they be sold to us? Then they held their peace, and found nothing to answer.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I said to them: We have [already] bought back our brother Jews [in captivity] who had been sold to the gentiles, with whatever [money] we had; yet you, too, would sell your brothers [impressed under you, to the gentiles], and [in the end] they would be sold to us [i.e., we would have to buy them back!] And they were [struck] silent [in shame] and they found nothing [to say].

And I said: This thing that you do is not good [(before the L-rd)]. Would you not pursue the fear of G d in the face of the shame of [i.e., your being shamed by] the gentiles, our foes!

I likewise, and my brethren, and my servants, have lent them money and corn: I pray you, let us release this debt.

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Return to them, now, as of this day, their fields, their vineyards, their olive orchards, and their houses, and most of the money and the grain and the wine and the oil wherein you are their creditors.

And they said: We shall return (it) and we shall ask nothing of them. We shall do exactly as you have said. And I called the priests and I beswore them to do as this thing [i.e., to waive their loans].

Also I shook out my lap, and said, So God shake out every man from his house, and from his labour, who does not perform this promise, even thus may he be shaken out, and emptied. And all the congregation said, Amen, and praised the Lord. And the people did according to this promise.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
I also shook out my hem and said: So shall G d shake out every man who does not fulfill this thing, of his house and of his toil [i.e., his possessions], and thus shall he remain shaken out and empty. And all the congregation said "Amen!" and they praised the L-rd, and the people did according to this thing [i.e., as they had averred.]

Also, from the day that he [(the king)] charged me to be governor of the land of Judah, from the twentieth year [(of the reign of King Darius, at which time Nechemiah went up from Bavel [viz. chapter 2])] until the thirty-second year of Artachshast [Darius] the king — twelve years — I and my brethren have not eaten the governor's bread [(a perquisite of the collection of taxes for the king)].

And the governors before me had imposed heavy [taxes] upon the people and had taken from them [for this service to the king] bread and wine, on top of forty silver shekels. And their youths, too, had lorded it over the people. But I did not do so, out of fear of G-d.

For I also continued in the work of this wall, nor did we buy any land: and all my servants were gathered there to the work.

Now that which was prepared for one day was one ox and six choice sheep; also fowls were prepared for me, and once in ten days store of all sorts of wine: yet for all this I did not demand the bread of the governor, because the bondage was heavy upon this people.

## Chapter 6

###### Nehemiah 6:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/6:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/6:1)


וַיְהִ֣י כַאֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁמַ֣ע לְסַנְבַלַּ֣ט וְ֠טוֹבִיָּ֠ה וּלְגֶ֨שֶׁם הָֽעַרְבִ֜י וּלְיֶ֣תֶר אֹֽיְבֵ֗ינוּ כִּ֤י בָנִ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־הַ֣חוֹמָ֔ה וְלֹא־נ֥וֹתַר בָּ֖הּ פָּ֑רֶץ גַּ֚ם עַד־הָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא דְּלָת֖וֹת לֹא־הֶעֱמַ֥דְתִּי בַשְּׁעָרִֽים׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Now it came to pass, when Sanvallat, and Toviyya, and Geshem the ῾Arvian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had built the wall, and that there was no breach left in it; (though at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates;)


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And it was, when it was heard by Sanvalat and Toviah and Geshem the Arab and the rest of our foes that I had built the wall and no breach remained in it, (and) also, (that) up to that time I had not set doors in the gates [(viz. verse 10)],


###### Nehemiah 6:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/6:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/6:2)


וַיִּשְׁלַ֨ח סַנְבַלַּ֤ט וְגֶ֙שֶׁם֙ אֵלַ֣י לֵאמֹ֔ר לְכָ֞ה וְנִֽוָּעֲדָ֥ה יַחְדָּ֛ו בַּכְּפִירִ֖ים בְּבִקְעַ֣ת אוֹנ֑וֹ וְהֵ֙מָּה֙ חֹֽשְׁבִ֔ים לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לִ֖י רָעָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
then Sanvallat and Geshem sent to me, saying, Come, let us meet together in one of the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
that Sanvalat and Geshem sent to me, saying: Go, and we will meet together in Kefirim in the valley of Ono (and [I understood that] they were plotting to do me evil [i.e., to kill me])


###### Nehemiah 6:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/6:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/6:3)


וָאֶשְׁלְחָ֨ה עֲלֵיהֶ֤ם מַלְאָכִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר מְלָאכָ֤ה גְדוֹלָה֙ אֲנִ֣י עֹשֶׂ֔ה וְלֹ֥א אוּכַ֖ל לָרֶ֑דֶת לָ֣מָּה תִשְׁבַּ֤ת הַמְּלָאכָה֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר אַרְפֶּ֔הָ וְיָרַדְתִּ֖י אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And I sent messengers to them, saying, I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down: why should the work cease, whilst I leave it, and come down to you?


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I sent to them messengers, saying: I am busy with a great project and I will not be able to come down. Why should the work halt? When I complete it, I will come down to you.


###### Nehemiah 6:4

In it, such words were written: It has been heard [(by all the gentiles)] and Gashmu [the Arab also] says: You and the Jews are plotting to rebel, wherefore you are building the wall, and you would be their king.

Afterwards I came to the house of Shema῾ya the son of Delaya the son of Mehetav᾽el, who was shut up; and he said, Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple, and let us shut the doors of the temple: for they will come to slay thee; yea, in the night they will come to slay thee.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I came to the house of Shemayah the son of Delayah the son of Mehetavel [(a false prophet, hired by Sanvalat and his cohorts to frighten Nechemiah into halting the work on the wall)], and he was at home. And he said: Let us meet in the house of G-d, in the midst of the sanctuary, and let us lock the doors of the sanctuary, for they are coming to kill you [(by way of the city gates, which were still without doors, [viz. 1])]; and they are coming to kill you tonight.

## Chapter 7

###### Nehemiah 7:1

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### Nehemiah 7:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/7:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/7:2)

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
that I charged Chanani my brother and Chananiah, chief of the capital with [the guarding of the gates of] Jerusalem, for he was a man of truth and feared G-d of yore.


###### Nehemiah 7:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/7:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/7:3)


(ויאמר) [וָאֹמַ֣ר] לָהֶ֗ם לֹ֣א יִפָּֽתְח֞וּ שַׁעֲרֵ֤י יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ עַד־חֹ֣ם הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ וְעַ֨ד הֵ֥ם עֹמְדִ֛ים יָגִ֥יפוּ הַדְּלָת֖וֹת וֶאֱחֹ֑זוּ וְהַעֲמֵ֗יד מִשְׁמְרוֹת֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם אִ֚ישׁ בְּמִשְׁמָר֔וֹ וְאִ֖ישׁ נֶ֥גֶד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃

And I said to them, Let not the gates of Yerushalayim be opened until the sun is hot; and while people are still standing there, let them shut the doors, and bar them: and appoint watches among the inhabitants of Yerushalayim everyone in his watch, and everyone to be over against his house.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And I said to them: Let the gates of Jerusalem not be opened until the heat of the day [i.e., midday]. [(While the gates were open, they were to remain standing there, and whoever wished to leave or enter did so at that time.)] And while they were [yet] standing [there], they were to take hold of the doors to close (them). And [("I said to them":)] Station watches (of) the inhabitants of Jerusalem, each in his watch and each opposite his house.


###### Nehemiah 7:4

###### Nehemiah 7:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/7:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/Nehemiah/r/7:5)

[And they commanded] that they make heard and proclaim throughout all of their cities and in Jerusalem: "Go out to the mountain and bring olive leaves and olive-tree leaves and myrtle leaves [(for roofing the succah)] and date-palm leaves [(for the lulav)] and leaves of a plaited tree [(hadassim)] to observe Succoth as written."

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

# I Chronicles

דברי הימים א

Link: [https://torahapp.org/share/book/I%20Chronicles](https://torahapp.org/share/book/I%20Chronicles)

חזרה על אירועים שכבר סופרו בתורה ובנביאים ראשונים, בדגש על קורותיו של דוד המלך.

Recounts of events in the Torah and early Prophets, focusing on King David.

Sections: Chapter-Verse

Location: Tanakh/Writings

Originally from [Sefaria](https://www.sefaria.org) via [TorahLM.org](https://torahlm.org) — see [licensing](https://torahlm.org/sefaria_license).

Version (He): Miqra according to the Masorah (Segments: 943, License: CC-BY-SA)

Versions (En):
  - The Koren Jerusalem Bible (Segments: 943, License: CC-BY-NC)
  - The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein (Segments: 942, License: CC-BY)

## Chapter 11

###### I Chronicles 11:1

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

וַ֠יָּבֹ֠אוּ כׇּל־זִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶל־הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ חֶבְר֔וֹנָה וַיִּכְרֹת֩ לָהֶ֨ם דָּוִ֥יד בְּרִ֛ית בְּחֶבְר֖וֹן לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיִּמְשְׁח֨וּ אֶת־דָּוִ֤יד לְמֶ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּיַד־שְׁמוּאֵֽל׃{ס}

# II Chronicles

דברי הימים ב

Link: [https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles](https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles)

חזרה על אירועים שסופרו בספרי הנביאים מימי שלמה ועד חורבן בית המקדש הראשון.

Recounts of events in the Prophets, from Solomon through the First Temple’s destruction.

## Chapter 1

###### II Chronicles 1:1

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

This is an ordinance for ever to Yisra᾽el.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the Ulam [(the entrance hall)], whose length ran along the breadth of the house, was twenty cubits [(from north to south)], and its height, one hundred and twenty; and he overlaid it with pure gold from within.

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

And the wings of the cherubs — their length was twenty cubits: one wing [(the outer)], five cubits (long), touching the [northern] wall of the house; and the other wing [(the inner)], five cubits (long), touching the [inner] wing of the other cherub.


###### II Chronicles 3:12

## Chapter 4

###### II Chronicles 4:1

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/4:1](https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/4:1)


וַיַּ֙עַשׂ֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח נְחֹ֔שֶׁת עֶשְׂרִ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אׇרְכּ֔וֹ וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה רׇחְבּ֑וֹ וְעֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת קוֹמָתֽוֹ׃{ס}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits its length, and twenty cubits its breadth, and ten cubits its height.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he made a copper altar, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits broad, and ten cubits high.


###### II Chronicles 4:2

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/4:2](https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/4:2)


וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־הַיָּ֖ם מוּצָ֑ק עֶ֣שֶׂר בָּ֠אַמָּ֠ה מִשְּׂפָת֨וֹ אֶל־שְׂפָת֜וֹ עָג֣וֹל**׀** סָבִ֗יב וְחָמֵ֤שׁ בָּֽאַמָּה֙ קוֹמָת֔וֹ וְקָו֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים בָּאַמָּ֔ה יָסֹ֥ב אֹת֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Also he made a molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass, and five cubits its height; and a line of thirty cubits did circle it round about.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he made the molten Sea [(a tub for the ritual immersion of he priests)], ten cubits from brim to brim. It was round all about, and its height was five cubits. And a line of thirty cubits compassed it.


###### II Chronicles 4:3

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/4:3](https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/4:3)


וּדְמ֣וּת בְּקָרִים֩ תַּ֨חַת ל֜וֹ סָבִ֤יב׀סָבִיב֙ סוֹבְבִ֣ים אֹת֔וֹ עֶ֚שֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה מַקִּיפִ֥ים אֶת־הַיָּ֖ם סָבִ֑יב שְׁנַ֤יִם טוּרִים֙ הַבָּקָ֔ר יְצוּקִ֖ים בְּמֻצַקְתּֽוֹ׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And under it was the likeness of oxen, which did circle it round about: ten in a cubit, compassing the sea round about. Two rows of oxen were cast with it, when it was cast.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the likeness of oxen was beneath it roundabout, compassing it; ten in a cubit, compassing the Sea roundabout. In two rows were the oxen cast when it [the Sea] was cast [(i.e., they were cast in one form, and not cast and superadded to it afterwards)].


###### II Chronicles 4:4

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/4:4](https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/4:4)


עוֹמֵ֞ד עַל־שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֗ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה פֹנִ֣ים׀צָפ֡וֹנָה וּשְׁלוֹשָׁה֩ פֹנִ֨ים׀יָ֜מָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה**׀** פֹּנִ֣ים נֶ֗גְבָּה וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פֹּנִ֣ים מִזְרָ֔חָה וְהַיָּ֥ם עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְכׇל־אֲחֹרֵיהֶ֖ם בָּֽיְתָה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
It stood upon twelve oxen, three looking towards the north, and three looking towards the west, and three looking towards the south, and three looking towards the east: and the sea was set above upon them, and all their hinder parts were inward.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
It stood on twelve [(brazen)] oxen, three turned to the north, three turned to the west, three turned to the south, and three turned to the east. And the Sea was (set) upon them from above. And all their hind parts faced inwards [i.e., those in the north to those in the south, and those in the east to those in the west].


###### II Chronicles 4:5

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/4:5](https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/4:5)


וְעׇבְי֣וֹ טֶ֔פַח וּשְׂפָתוֹ֙ כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה שְׂפַת־כּ֔וֹס פֶּ֖רַח שׁוֹשַׁנָּ֑ה מַחֲזִ֣יק בַּתִּ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים יָכִֽיל׃{ס}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And the thickness of it was a handbreadth, and the brim of it like the work of the brim of a cup, like the petals of a lily; and it received and contained three thousand bats.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And its thickness was a handbreadth, but its rim [(was thinner)], wrought like the brim of a [drinking] cup [and decorated with] flower and lily. It contained three thousand bath [(a type of measure)].


###### II Chronicles 4:6

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/4:6](https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/4:6)


וַיַּ֣עַשׂ כִּיּוֹרִים֮ עֲשָׂרָה֒ וַ֠יִּתֵּ֠ן חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה מִיָּמִ֜ין וַחֲמִשָּׁ֤ה מִשְּׂמֹאול֙ לְרׇחְצָ֣ה בָהֶ֔ם אֶת־מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה הָעוֹלָ֖ה יָדִ֣יחוּ בָ֑ם וְהַיָּ֕ם לְרׇחְצָ֥ה לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בּֽוֹ׃{ס}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
He made also ten lavers, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them: such things as belonged to the burnt offering they washed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And he made ten lavers. And he placed five on the right and five on the left [for the priests] to wash their hands and feet with [(and)] in which to rinse the burnt-offering portions. And the Sea was for the priests to immerse in.


###### II Chronicles 4:7

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/4:7](https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/4:7)


וַ֠יַּ֠עַשׂ אֶת־מְנֹר֧וֹת הַזָּהָ֛ב עֶ֖שֶׂר כְּמִשְׁפָּטָ֑ם וַיִּתֵּן֙ בַּֽהֵיכָ֔ל חָמֵ֥שׁ מִיָּמִ֖ין וְחָמֵ֥שׁ מִשְּׂמֹֽאול׃{ס}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And he made ten candlesticks of gold according to their prescribed form, and set them in the temple, five on the right hand, and five on the left.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
You will hear in heaven, the abode of Your dwelling, and You will do according to all that the stranger calls to You [(as opposed to verse 30: "and You will give to the man (an Israelite) according to all of his ways," a Jew being ready to attribute non-materialization of his prayers to his own deficiencies; a stranger, only to the non-existence of a Hearer)], so that all the peoples of the land know Your name, to fear You as (do) Your people Israel, and to know that Your name is called upon this house that I have built.

יְהִ֨י יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ בָּר֔וּךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר**׀** חָפֵ֣ץ בְּךָ֗ לְתִתְּךָ֤ עַל־כִּסְאוֹ֙ לְמֶ֔לֶךְ לַֽיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּאַהֲבַ֨ת אֱלֹהֶ֤יךָ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְהַעֲמִיד֣וֹ לְעוֹלָ֔ם וַיִּתֶּנְךָ֤ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ לְמֶ֔לֶךְ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
Blessed be the Lord thy God, who delighted in thee to set thee on his throne, to be king for the Lord thy God: because thy God loved Yisra᾽el, to establish them for ever, therefore he made thee king over them, to do judgment and justice.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
Blessed be the L rd your G d who desired you, to place you on His throne as king for the L rd your G d in the love of your G d for Israel to establish them forever. And He made you a king over them to do justice and righteousness.


###### II Chronicles 9:9

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/9:9](https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/9:9)


וַתִּתֵּ֨ן לַמֶּ֜לֶךְ מֵאָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֣ים**׀** כִּכַּ֣ר זָהָ֗ב וּבְשָׂמִ֛ים לָרֹ֥ב מְאֹ֖ד וְאֶ֣בֶן יְקָרָ֑ה וְלֹ֤א הָיָה֙ כַּבֹּ֣שֶׂם הַה֔וּא אֲשֶׁר־נָתְנָ֥ה מַֽלְכַּת־שְׁבָ֖א לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**
And she gave the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and of spices great abundance, and precious stones: nor was there any such spice as the queen of Sheva gave king Shelomo.


**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And she gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, and very much spices and precious stones. There was not the like of those spices that the queen of Sheva gave to King Solomon.


###### II Chronicles 9:10

[https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/9:10](https://torahapp.org/share/book/II%20Chronicles/r/9:10)


וְגַם־עַבְדֵ֤י (חירם) [חוּרָם֙] וְעַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִ֥יאוּ זָהָ֖ב מֵאוֹפִ֑יר הֵבִ֛יאוּ עֲצֵ֥י אַלְגּוּמִּ֖ים וְאֶ֥בֶן יְקָרָֽה׃

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**

###### II Chronicles 9:11

וַיַּ֣עַשׂ הַ֠מֶּ֠לֶךְ אֶת־עֲצֵ֨י הָאַלְגּוּמִּ֜ים מְסִלּ֤וֹת לְבֵית־יְהֹוָה֙ וּלְבֵ֣ית הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְכִנֹּר֥וֹת וּנְבָלִ֖ים לַשָּׁרִ֑ים וְלֹא־נִרְא֥וּ כָהֵ֛ם לְפָנִ֖ים בְּאֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָֽה׃

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And the king made of the coral-wood a paving for the house of the L rd and for the house of the king, and harps and psalteries for the singers [(the Levites)]. The like of them had not been seen before in the land of Judah.


###### II Chronicles 9:12

וְהַמֶּ֨לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה נָתַ֣ן לְמַֽלְכַּת־שְׁבָ֗א אֶת־כׇּל־חֶפְצָהּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁאָ֔לָה מִלְּבַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר־הֵבִ֣יאָה אֶל־הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַֽתַּהֲפֹ֛ךְ וַתֵּ֥לֶךְ לְאַרְצָ֖הּ הִ֥יא וַעֲבָדֶֽיהָ׃{פ}


**The Koren Jerusalem Bible:**

**The Rashi Ketuvim by Rabbi Shraga Silverstein:**
And King Solomon gave the queen of Sheva all of her desire that she asked [i.e., he taught her wisdom], aside from [what he had given her for] what she had brought to the king. And she turned and went to her land, she and her servants.
